title: TextureSwapper
description: Automatically switches your resource packs on every lobby or instance change, with smart randomisation to keep things fresh.
body:
**Texture Swapper** (**TSR**) is a mod that automatically switches your resource pack whenever you join a world, server, server instance or lobby.

Originally created for Hypixel SkyBlock upon the suggestion of a friend, **TSR** works in any environment where frequent instance switching occurs. It adds variety to your gameplay by rotating through your favourite resource packs, without you needing to manually change them.

### Features
- Automatically swaps resource packs on instance/lobby change
- Works even with small hops (e.g. SkyBlock servers, minigames)
- Smart randomization that reduces repeating the last used pack
- Dedicated resource pack folder (no interference with your main packs)
- Simple in-game setup with commands and a basic GUI
- Lightweight and focused functionality

### Commands
/tsr or /textureswapper
- create — Create a new texture swap profile (opens folder for adding packs)
- edit — Modify your selected resource packs via a simple GUI
- reload — Reload the current configuration

### How it works
TSR uses its own resource pack directory to avoid conflicts with your main Minecraft setup.
Whenever a new instance is detected, the mod reloads resources and selects a pack from your configured list using a randomness system that avoids picking the same pack repeatedly.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.10
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

**Notes**
- TSR only supports resource packs (no shader support)
- The mod triggers a resource reload on each instance change, which may briefly show the loading screen
- For a smoother experience, using a mod like [Remove Reloading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrls) is recommended

### Why use TSR?
If you enjoy using multiple resource packs but don’t want to constantly switch between them, TSR automates the process and keeps your visuals feeling fresh — especially in games with frequent lobby or instance changes.

This is a niche mod by design, but for the right use case, it adds a unique and dynamic twist to your Minecraft experience.
